# Third-Party Notices

This file is the deterministic delivery NOTICE surface for approved, shipped
open-source inputs. It is intentionally empty of component notices until the
license policy records an approved delivery decision, license text reference,
and any required source offer. Research-only, blocked, and unclassified inputs
are excluded rather than silently treated as shipped.

Run `node tools/security/check-oss-license-policy.mjs` to generate the current
machine-readable report before preparing a delivery-specific NOTICE bundle.
